p.src: 1  When the LORD brought back those who returned to Zion, we were like those who dream.

en: When the LORD brought back those who returned to Zion, we were like those who dream.
u.src: 1  When the LORD brought back those who returned to Zion, we were like those who dream.

p.src: 2  Then our mouth was filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing. Then they said among the nations, “The LORD has done great things for them.”

en: Then our mouth was filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing. Then they said among the nations, “The LORD has done great things for them.”
u.src: 2  Then our mouth was filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing. Then they said among the nations, “The LORD has done great things for them.”

p.src: 3  The LORD has done great things for us, and we are glad.

en: The LORD has done great things for us, and we are glad.
u.src: 3  The LORD has done great things for us, and we are glad.

p.src: 4  Restore our fortunes again, LORD, like the streams in the Negev.

en: Restore our fortunes again, LORD, like the streams in the Negev.
u.src: 4  Restore our fortunes again, LORD, like the streams in the Negev.

p.src: 5  Those who sow in tears will reap in joy.

en: Those who sow in tears will reap in joy.
u.src: 5  Those who sow in tears will reap in joy.

p.src: 6  He who goes out weeping, carrying seed for sowing, will certainly come again with joy, carrying his sheaves.

en: He who goes out weeping, carrying seed for sowing, will certainly come again with joy, carrying his sheaves.
u.src: 6  He who goes out weeping, carrying seed for sowing, will certainly come again with joy, carrying his sheaves.
